timeline.text: Gordiy's app taught him letters by the calendar — two new ones a week, counting from day one of school.
But his real classroom started in week forty-two, taught letters in its own order.
By November, the app was quizzing him on letters his class hadn't even reached yet.
So a small Cloudflare Workers job reads the class's own weekly plan and publishes the real order instead.
Gordiy's known-letters list finally matches his class — closing a gap of about fifteen letters.
